excerpt.zh: 这颗微型行星上的森林预示着有趣的发现。
excerpt.en: The forests on this planetoid bear promises of interesting finds.

texts.zh: 这颗微型行星上的森林预示着有趣的发现。
texts.en: The forests on this planetoid bear promises of interesting finds.

sections.zh: 这颗微型行星上的森林预示着有趣的发现。
sections.en: The forests on this planetoid bear promises of interesting finds.

texts.zh: [From.GetName]的森林让船员们大吃一惊。这不仅仅是一个充斥着各种有机生物的高度发展的世界，而且大部分植物的根茎都能吃。或许不算美味，但这代表我们可以轻易地在[From.GetPlanetMoon]的肥沃土壤上耕种。
texts.en: The forests of [From.GetName] have blown the crew's expectations away. It is not only a highly developed world rich in organic life, but most plant roots are even edible. This might not sound appetizing, but it indicates that we could easily grow food on this [From.GetPlanetMoon], due to the rich soil.

tooltips.en: Adds the Lush Planet modifier to [From.GetName].

title.en: The Rulers of the Water Plains

texts.zh:
在[From.GetName]上，科学官[Root.GetLeaderName]发现了一种身体健壮、适应力极强的四足哺乳生物。他们可以徒步涉水，即使是高大的植物也仅仅达到它们的腿部。 这些生物的暗色鳞片非常坚硬，而且在陌生人靠近时极易受惊。

也许可以驯服这些猛兽，让它们协助我们将来的行星殖民活动。但先研究它们也许会有所收获。
texts.en:
On [From.GetName], Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] has discovered a race of quadruped mammalians who appear very strong and physically resilient. They run across shallow plains of water, with lush plants reaching for their legs. The dark scales of the creatures are rock hard, and they are very skittish when approached.

It might be possible to domesticate the beasts and have them assist in potential future colonization of the planet. However, we might however happen across some interesting revelations by studying them first.

texts.zh:
在[From.GetName]上，科学官[Root.GetLeaderName]发现了一种身体健壮、适应力极强的四足哺乳生物。他们可以徒步涉水，即使是高大的植物也仅仅达到它们的腿部。

[Root.GetLeaderName]发现这种动物有某种灵能能力，从它们的行为变化上看，它们可以感应到我们的意图。

也许可以驯服这些猛兽，让它们协助我们将来的行星殖民活动。但先研究它们也许会有所收获。

[Root.GetLeaderName]说这些当地生物会“对不怀好意的人反馈负面回应”。
texts.en:
On [From.GetName], Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] has discovered a race of quadruped mammalians who appear very strong and physically resilient. They run across shallow plains of water, with lush plants reaching for their legs.

[Root.GetLeaderName] have been able to deduce that the animals have some sort of psionic ability, as changes in their demeanor indicates that they are able to intuitively sense our intentions.

It might be possible to domesticate the beasts and have them assist in potential future colonization of the planet. However, we might however happen across some interesting revelations by studying them first.

[Root.GetLeaderName] claims that the indigenous creatures seem to "respond negatively to thoughts that indicate any sort of threat."

label.zh: 研究它们，找出更多信息。
label.en: Study them to find out more.
Try to domesticate them right away.

label.zh: 让它们自由自在地生活。

texts.zh: 一个宏伟的哺乳动物种群漫步在水草丰茂的旷野。他们似乎对我们的靠近有点不安。近距离的研究能带给我们更多的信息。
texts.en: A majestic race of mammals roam fields of water grass. They seem skittish and have insight into our approaches. Studying them up close could give us more information.

title.en: The Rulers of the Water Plains

texts.zh:
我们试图靠近它们做研究，但进展并不顺利。它们一发现我们靠近，就要么逃走要么战斗，它们好像从大老远就能发现我们。

这些动物明显清楚我们的意图，所以尽量避免跟我们接触。

至少我们可以从远距离研究它们，也许会有所发现。
texts.en:
Our attempts to study the animals up close has yielded few results. They run away or fight back as soon as we approach, as if they knew we are coming way before we have even sighted their herds.

The beasts clearly understand what we are trying to do, somehow, and avoid being in close proximity to us.

At least we can keep studying them from afar and maybe learn something interesting.

label.zh: 这最起码是一种意志坚定的动物。
label.en: A strong-willed animal to say the least.

title.en: The Rulers of the Water Plains

texts.zh:
接触这些动物的进展相当顺利！它们似乎拥有一种灵能感应，可以通过精神彼此沟通以及跟我们沟通。

它们想要自由自在地生活在大地上，尽情享受那里的水果。如果我们不打扰它们的生存空间和食物，它们愿意在必要时帮助我们。

这段佳话应当被广泛传播到人们的耳中。
texts.en:
Approaching the animals have yielded results! They appear to have psionic capabilities, able to communicate with each other, and us, via telepathy.

They wish to be free, roam the land and eat of its fruits. We would have their support, as fellow creatures of the cosmos, if we simply allow them their space and leave their food sources untouched.

Positive stories of how this situation was resolved is bound to spread to the general populace.

label.en: We need the food for ourselves.

title.en: The Rulers of the Water Plains

texts.zh: 这些动物非常难以驯服。为了靠近它们，我们被迫使用了暴力和麻醉剂。我们要驱使它们的时候，它们总是反抗。我们必须强迫它们完成工作，但效果不太好。
texts.en: The animals are proving difficult to tame. In order to get even close to them we have to use some force and eventually sedate them. They consistently fight back when we try to put them to work. We will have to force them to perform their tasks, which hasn't turned out to be very efficient.

title.en: The Rulers of the Water Plains

texts.zh:
这些动物非常难以相处。虽然我们已经尽可能地温柔了，但其中一部分还是逃走和反抗。我们聚集了比较温驯的一批，训练它们工作。但其中一部分还是抗拒了。我们现在有一小群个体愿意帮忙我们，但这相比整支族群明显低效了很多。

我们驯服这些动物的消息一旦传入大众耳中，可能会对我们的声誉造成负面影响。
texts.en:
The animals have been difficult to work with. While we have been as gentle as possible in our advance, some of them still flee and resist. We have gathered the calmer specimens and made them work the earth for tests. Some rejected that too. We now have a small selection of individuals that are willing to help us, but they will not be as effective as the entire herd.

The way we enslaved these animals may paint us in a bad light, once word spreads to the general populace.

texts.zh:
[Root.GetName]出大事了！研究结束后并无重大发现，船员便返回到船上，却发现[From.GetPlanetMoon]的某只猛兽竟然跑上了船！

该生物已经杀害了一位船员，并正在撕毁墙壁试图逼近其他的船员们。他们撑不了多久！已经发布一个特殊项目去救人了。
texts.en:
Catastrophe has struck the [Root.GetName]! After conducting their studies, with no interesting finds, the crew returned to the ship only to find it carrying a beast from the [From.GetPlanetMoon]! 

The creature has already killed a crew member and is trying to claw itself through the walls to get to the others. They won't last long at this rate! A Special Project has been issued to save the ship.

texts.zh:
[Root.GetName]发生了大灾难！在进行研究而一无所获之后，船员们返回飞船时却发现上面有一只来自[From.GetPlanetMoon]的有机体猛兽！

这只猛兽已经瘫痪了一个船员单位，且正在撕毁墙壁试图逼近其他的单位。这样下去他们活不长了！拯救舰船的特殊项目已经发布。
texts.en:
Catastrophe has struck the [Root.GetName]! After conducting their studies, with no interesting finds, the crew returned to the ship only to find it carrying an organic beast from the [From.GetPlanetMoon]! 

The creature has already rendered one crew member unit inoperable, and is trying to claw itself through the walls to get to the others. They won't last long at this rate! A Special Project has been issued to save the ship.

texts.zh: [Root.Owner.GetMonsterOnShipDesc]
texts.en: [Root.Owner.GetMonsterOnShipDesc]

texts.zh: 我们的救援队成功击毙了[From.From.GetName]上的那只猛兽。科学专员[From.From.GetLeaderName]和船员们都受到了惊吓，但依然能够胜任各自的职务。他们非常感激士兵们的援救，这件事激发了人们参军的热情。
texts.en: Our rescue force has been successful in gunning down the beast aboard the [From.From.GetName]. Science Officer [From.From.GetLeaderName] and the team are rather traumatized, but assure that they are still fit for duty. Their appreciation of the soldiers saving them goes viral and we can already see a boost in new enlistees.

texts.zh:
我们的救援队成功地消灭了[From.From.GetName]上的猛兽。科学专员[From.From.GetLeaderName]及其团队只受到了轻微的损伤，并仍可执行任务。武装单元成功排除有机威胁的行动引起了机械合成工厂对于机械安全的广泛重视。

因此，我们的作战单元的建造速度以及动机软件的有效性已有所提高。
texts.en:
Our rescue force has been successful in gunning down the beast aboard the [From.From.GetName]. Science Officer [From.From.GetLeaderName] and the team have sustained negligible damage, and are still fit for duty. The success of our armed units in dispatching the organic menace has roused renewed focus among the assembly yards responsible for their construction.

As a result, we are noting an increase in combat unit build-speed and motivation software effectuality.

label.en: A proud day for the navy!

tooltips.zh: 你的帝国获得了受鼓舞的陆军新兵修正。
tooltips.en: Your Empire gains the Inspired Army Recruits modifier.

label.en: A proud day for the navy!

tooltips.zh: 你的帝国获得集中化陆军单元组装器修正。
tooltips.en: Your Empire gains the Focused Army Unit Assemblers modifier.

texts.zh:
我们的救援队成功击毙了[From.From.GetName]上的那只猛兽。可惜他们没能及时拯救科学专员[From.From.GetLeaderName]，后者为了保护船员们而阵亡了。

至少飞船无损，船员们很快就可以恢复工作。我们的母星沸腾了，都为我们的士兵们的英勇行为点赞。
texts.en:
Our rescue force has been successful in gunning down the beast aboard the [From.From.GetName]. Sadly they didn't make it in time to save Science Officer [From.From.GetLeaderName] who died while trying to protect the crew.

At least the ship is intact and the crew says they can go back to work soon. Our homeworld becomes abuzz about our military's bravery in handling the situation.

texts.zh:
我们的救援队成功地消灭了[From.From.GetName]上的猛兽。不幸的是，他们未能及时拯救试图保护船员而受到了致命损伤的科学专员[From.From.GetLeaderName]。

至少舰船依旧完好无损，而船上其它单位表示他们很快就能恢复正常机能。我们母星主控电路正忙于升级军事相关算法以更好的应对未来可能发生的类似事件。
texts.en:
Our rescue force has been successful in gunning down the beast aboard the [From.From.GetName]. Unfortunately, they didn't make it in time to save Science Officer [From.From.GetLeaderName], who took terminal damage while trying to protect the crew units.

At least the ship is intact and the crew informs us they can resume normal functions soon. Our homeworld's circuits are abuzz with updates on our military's efficacy in handling the situation.

tooltips.zh:
失去舰船上的科学家。
你的帝国获得了受鼓舞的陆军新兵修正。
tooltips.en:
Lose the ship's Science Leader.
Your Empire gains the Inspired Army Recruits modifier.

tooltips.zh:
失去舰船上的科学家。
你的帝国获得了集中化陆军单元组装器修正。
tooltips.en:
Lose the ship's Science Leader.
Your Empire gains the Focused Army Unit Assemblers modifier.

texts.zh:
被怪兽侵袭的飞船发来了最后的电报。那些野兽已经成功突破到了船员藏身的地方。

情况太过残忍，就不多做描述了。没有生还者。
texts.en:
A last transmission has been received from the monster-infested ship. It tells us that the beast succeeded in getting through to the crew's hiding place.

The horrid encounter was far too graphic to describe. There were no survivors.

texts.zh:
[From.GetName]的表面屹立着值得注意的建筑群。这些遗迹拥有不同的建筑风格，但都建于同一时代。[From.GetPlanetMoon]曾经可能是一个交易中心。

某些遗迹中存有文档和财物。我们可以通过研究文本来尝试翻译，以便了解曾定居在这里的生物。我们也可以将其卖给古董收藏家。
texts.en:
The surface of [From.GetName] holds something remarkable. Multiple ruins can be found, built using different architectures, yet from the same point in history. The [From.GetPlanetMoon] might have been a trading hub!

Some ruins held stored documents and valuables. If we studied the texts we might be able to translate them and learn more about the people who settled here. Or we could sell them to someone who values old heirlooms.

label.en: Send it to our homeworld for research.
Sell it to a private collector.

texts.zh: 我们在一个貌似星际贸易站的废墟中发现了一些文本。如果我们能够翻译这些文件，我们可以更多地了解那些建立它的人。
texts.en: We've found some texts among the ruins of a possible interstellar trading hub. If we translate these documents we could learn more about the ones who founded it.

texts.zh:
谁能想到呢？我们发现的文献记录了更多“说书人特丽莎”的教诲。

这份文档记录了一些奇闻趣事、如何从星际外交中获取最大利益的建议和技巧。她相信，公平贸易和互相尊重的沟通可以为各界带来巨大的社会进步。
texts.en:
Who would've thought? The texts we found were more teachings from "Telisa the Teller of Tales."

The documents we found were a collection of anecdotes, suggestions and techniques for how to optimally partake in interstellar diplomacy. She seemed to have believed that good trade and respectful communication would achieve great social advancements for all parties.

texts.zh:
我们天才的语言学专家正在努力翻译[From.From.From.GetName]上发现的文献。文献的作者被称作“说书人特丽莎”，似乎是当时的德高望重之人。

这份文档记录了一些奇闻趣事、如何从星际外交中获取最大利益的建议和技巧。她相信，公平贸易和互相尊重的沟通可以为各界带来巨大的社会进步。
texts.en:
Our most talented linguists have been hard at work in translating the documents we found on [From.From.From.GetName]. The scribe behind these works is referred to as "Telisa the Teller of Tales," and it seems she was highly revered during her time.

The documents we found were a collection of anecdotes, suggestions and techniques for how to optimally partake in interstellar diplomacy. She seemed to have believed that good trade and respectful communication would achieve great social advancements for all parties.

tooltips.zh: 可以使用大师的教诲：外交信任的帝国法令。
tooltips.en: Gives access to the Master's Teachings: Diplomatic Trust Empire Edict.

texts.zh: 十分可惜，我们的语言学家未能完全理解[From.From.From.GetName]上古老文献的外星语言。不过，他们翻译了一些核心内容，让我们得以窥探那个文明的文化。
texts.en: Sadly our linguists have been unable to understand the entirety of the alien language used in the old documents found on [From.From.From.GetName]. However, they managed to translate the essentials, which has given us a glimpse into the culture they originated from.
